# @ratmath/complex

> Complex and hypercomplex numbers for RatMath: exact complex arithmetic, honest branches, certified complex analysis, quaternions and octonions. Part of the RatMath Shelf; numbers come from @ratmath/core (a peer dependency). ESM: `import * as complex from "@ratmath/complex"`.

Built from 0.3.0, commit 5801d7f plus uncommitted changes. `file:line` is relative to the package root (also node_modules/@ratmath/complex/); on GitHub: https://github.com/ratmath/complex/blob/5801d7f/<file>#L<line>. Docs pages are under https://ratmath.com/complex/. Full types: index.d.ts.

Types: `type RationalLike = Rational | bigint | number | string`; `type ComplexLike = Complex | RationalLike | readonly [RationalLike, RationalLike] | { re: RationalLike; im: RationalLike }`; `type Enclosable = ComplexLike | Rect | Disc`; `type IntervalLike = RationalLike | RationalInterval | Bounds | readonly [RationalLike, RationalLike]`; `type Side = "above" | "below" | "right" | "left"`; `type Precision = number | { bits?: number }`; `type FunctionName = "exp" | "sin" | "cos" | "tan" | "sinh" | "cosh" | "tanh" | "log" | "sqrt" | "asin" | "acos" | "atan" | "asinh" | "acosh" | "atanh"`; `type Infinity = typeof infinity`; `type SpherePoint = ComplexLike | Infinity`; `type MobiusKind = "identity" | "elliptic" | "parabolic" | "hyperbolic" | "loxodromic"`; `type AnalyticFunction = string | ((z: CTM) => CTM | Enclosable) | { type: string }`; `type ContourLike = Contour | Rect | Disc | readonly ComplexLike[]`

## Docs

- https://ratmath.com/complex/llms-full.txt: every page below as Markdown, each with a runnable example
- Pages: index (Overview), reference (Reference), explore (Explore), numbers (Complex rationals), enclosures (Rectangles and discs), polar (Polar form), functions (Functions), branches (Branches), mobius (Möbius maps), riemann-sphere (The Riemann sphere), taylor-models (Taylor models), contour-integrals (Contour integrals), zeros (Zeros and the argument principle), residues (Residues and Laurent series), real-integrals (Real integrals by residues), gamma-zeta (Gamma and zeta), cayley-dickson (Cayley–Dickson numbers), rotations (Rotations), integer-quaternions (Integer quaternions)

## Example

```js
import { complex, rect, exp, sqrt, pow, asin, Contour, contourIntegral, countZeros, zeta, zetaZeros } from "@ratmath/complex";
// Euler's identity, as far as it can be known: exp(iπ) with π enclosed.
const pi = [new Rational("3.14159265358979"), new Rational("3.14159265358980")];
console.log("exp(i·[π]) =", exp(rect([0, 0], pi)).toString());

// (3 + 4i)/5 is on the unit circle, so every power of it is too, exactly.
const z = complex("3/5 + 4/5i");
console.log("z^10 =", z.pow(10).toString(), "  |z^10|² =", z.pow(10).norm().toString());

// A function on its cut tells you so.
console.log("sqrt(-4)  →", sqrt("-4").toString());
console.log("asin(2)   →", asin("2").toString());

// i^i is real
console.log("i^i =", pow("i", "i").toString());

// The doubling ladder: what each level gives up
for (const level of [1, 2, 3, 4]) {
  const p = cayleyDickson(level).properties();
  console.log(p.name.padEnd(16), "commutative:", p.commutative, " associative:", p.associative, " zero divisors:", p.zeroDivisors ? p.zeroDivisors.join(" times ") + " = 0" : "none");
}

// A contour integral, a count of zeros, and the first zero of zeta
console.log("∮ dz/z round the unit circle =", contourIntegral("1/z", Contour.circle(0, 1)).toString());
console.log("solutions of e^z = 3z with |z| < 2:", countZeros("exp(z) - 3z", Contour.circle(0, 2)));
const first = zetaZeros(14, 15).zeros[0];
console.log("first zero of ζ:", first.enclosure.toString(18), "  proved on the critical line:", first.onCriticalLine);
zeta(2).toString(18)
```
